info.name: Car Rental API v1
info.description: Public catalogue and quotes, plus bookings (sign in first). Run the local stack first (the API listens on port 4000) (see docs/api-testing.md). Dates are generated automatically, 30 days ahead.

item.name: Auth
Sign in (local test customer)
Sign in (staff)
Sign in (admin)
Sign up (a brand new customer)

exec: pm.test('signed up and signed in', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json().access_token).to.be.a('string') })

item.name: Catalogue
List classes

exec: pm.test('200 and a list of classes', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.length).to.be.above(0) })

item.name: List classes with availability (dates)
List classes in USD (display only)

exec: pm.test('USD display, KES unchanged', () => { const c = pm.response.json().data[0]; pm.expect(c.display_currency).to.eql('USD'); pm.expect(c.price_per_day_kes).to.eql(12500) })

item.name: Get one class

exec: pm.test('200 and the class name', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.name).to.eql('Executive Sedan') })

item.name: List locations
Check availability
Quotes
Quote: office pickup, 3 days

exec: pm.test('201 and priced from the rate table', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(201); const d = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(d.total_kes).to.eql(37500); pm.expect(d.deposit_kes).to.eql(11250) })
pm.test('deposit is labelled Refundable deposit', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.breakdown.map(l => l.label)).to.include('Refundable deposit'))

item.name: Quote: delivery with chauffeur (worked example)

exec: pm.test('KES 45,000 total, KES 13,500 deposit', () => { const d = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(d.total_kes).to.eql(45000); pm.expect(d.deposit_kes).to.eql(13500) })

item.name: Quote: 7 days, weekly discount, USD display

exec: pm.test('10% weekly discount applied, USD display fixed at the quote', () => { const d = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(d.total_kes).to.eql(78750); pm.expect(d.display.currency).to.eql('USD'); pm.expect(d.breakdown.some(l => l.kind === 'discount')).to.be.true })

item.name: Quote: 1-day rental (charged as 2 days)
Quote: airport transfer, 1 day
Accounts (sign in, sign up, staff first)
Me: my profile

exec: pm.test('profile with role and company', () => { const d = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(d.role).to.eql('customer'); pm.expect(d).to.have.property('company') })

item.name: Me: the brand new customer sees their own profile

exec: pm.test('profile created at sign-up, role customer', () => { const d = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(d.full_name).to.eql('Postman New Customer'); pm.expect(d.role).to.eql('customer') })

item.name: Me: change my name and marketing choice

exec: pm.test('updated', () => { const d = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(d.full_name).to.eql('Postman Renamed'); pm.expect(d.marketing_opt_in).to.be.true })

item.name: Me: try to make myself an admin (should be refused)

exec: pm.test('400, the role cannot be changed here', () => pm.response.to.have.status(400))

Admin: switch the team member off

Bookings (sign in first)
Create booking from the last quote

exec: pm.test('201, pending payment, vehicle held', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(201); const d = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(d.status).to.eql('pending_payment'); pm.expect(d.reference).to.match(/^BK-/) })

item.name: Create booking without signing in
List my bookings
List my bookings, one per page

exec: pm.test('one booking; next_cursor when there are more', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().data).to.have.lengthOf(1))

item.name: Get one booking (timeline)

exec: pm.test('timeline: Quote done, Deposit paid current', () => { const t = pm.response.json().data.timeline; pm.expect(t[0].state).to.eql('done'); pm.expect(t[1].state).to.eql('current') })

item.name: Cancel and change a booking (sign in first)
Quote for a booking to cancel
Book it
See what cancelling would cost before confirming

exec: pm.test('nothing was paid, so no refund', () => { const d = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(d.policy_window).to.eql('nothing_paid'); pm.expect(d.refund_kes).to.eql(0); pm.expect(d.can_cancel).to.be.true })

item.name: Change the dates (the one change allowed)

exec: pm.test('re-priced, one change used', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const d = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(d.booking.date_changes).to.eql(1); pm.expect(d.breakdown.length).to.be.above(0) })

exec: pm.test('201 with the signed document', () => { pm.expect([201,409]).to.include(pm.response.code); if (pm.response.code === 201) pm.environment.set('agreement_document_id', pm.response.json().data.document_id) })

item.name: Staff: upload the file to the signed link (storage, not the API)
Staff: record a pickup inspection with the document

body.raw:
{
  "booking_id": "{{booking_id}}",
  "type": "pickup",
  "fuel_level": "full",
  "mileage_km": 12000,
  "condition_notes": "Small scratch on the rear bumper.",
  "damage_noted": true,
  "files": [
    {
      "kind": "document",
      "label": "Signed condition sheet",
      "storage_path": "{{inspection_path}}",
      "content_type": "application/pdf",
      "size_bytes": 18
    }
  ]
}

exec: pm.test('201 with the file, and no storage path shown', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(201); const d = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(d.files.length).to.eql(1); pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.not.include('storage_path') })
